answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the ocean graph. Re-attestations are stored in onyx and signal lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 400 impostors cost 1469 times the honest price and take 22 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
